tokens.name: surface-trench
tokens.usage: Level -2. Deep wells: slider, switch and progress tracks. Never holds body text larger than a label.

tokens.name: surface-well
tokens.usage: Level -1. Receptacles: inputs, textareas, the tab track. Things you put something into.

tokens.name: surface-ground
tokens.usage: Level 0. The page itself, and anything flush with it: badges, ghost buttons, skeletons, disabled controls.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Level 1. Resting interactive and grouping surfaces: cards, buttons, the switch thumb, the active tab.

tokens.name: surface-lifted
tokens.usage: Level 2. A raised surface under the pointer, and the primary action at rest.

tokens.name: surface-floating
tokens.usage: Level 3. Tooltips, popovers, menus, a dragged item.

tokens.name: surface-overlay
tokens.usage: Level 4. Toasts and sheets.

tokens.name: surface-modal
tokens.usage: Level 5. Dialogs. The highest thing on screen, one at a time.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on every surface-* level and on accent-soft.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, hints, placeholders; on every surface-* level.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Disabled labels only (exempt from contrast minimums). Never for content.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines: dividers, the separators between flush accordion rows. Not a control boundary.

tokens.name: line-control
tokens.usage: Control boundaries (input, checkbox, radio, switch track): at least 3:1 on ground, well and raised.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The scheme's one hue: primary fills, checked controls, the switch and slider fill, progress.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill.

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Accent as text, links and the focus ring; 4.5:1 on every surface-* level.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind accent-ink or ink: the accent badge, the selected menu row.

tokens.name: positive
tokens.usage: Success text and icons on every surface-* level and on positive-soft. Always paired with a word or icon.

tokens.name: positive-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind positive text: success alerts, badges, toasts.

tokens.name: caution
tokens.usage: Warning text and icons on every surface-* level and on caution-soft. Always paired with a word or icon.

tokens.name: caution-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind caution text.

tokens.name: critical
tokens.usage: Errors and destructive actions: text and icons on every surface-* level and on critical-soft; the danger button fill.

tokens.name: critical-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind critical text; the invalid field's well.

tokens.name: on-critical
tokens.usage: Text on a critical fill (the danger button).

tokens.name: presence-1
tokens.usage: Collaborator presence: the ring and name tag on something another person is holding or editing. 3:1 on every surface.

tokens.name: presence-2
tokens.usage: Second collaborator's presence colour.

tokens.name: presence-3
tokens.usage: Third collaborator's presence colour.

tokens.name: on-presence
tokens.usage: Name-tag text on any presence-* fill.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: The veil a dialog lays over everything beneath it.

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Instrument Sans, hosted on Google Fonts (wght 400–700). Tight tracking as size grows.

styles.name: text-display
styles.usage: Marketing and empty-state headlines. Once per view.

styles.name: text-body
styles.sample: Changes save as you type and sync across devices.

styles.name: text-label
styles.usage: Buttons, inputs, menu items, tabs, field labels.

spacing.note: 4px base. Padding inside a raised surface grows with its level: cards space-5, popovers space-2 to space-3, dialogs space-6.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap inside small controls; the inset of a tab indicator in its track.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap in buttons; menu padding; gap between stacked toasts.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Horizontal padding of small buttons and inputs; gap between related fields.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Horizontal padding of medium buttons; gap between form rows.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Dialog padding; gap between sections in a card.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Page gutters on wide screens.

radius.note: Concentric: a surface nested inside another takes the outer radius minus the gap between them (tab indicator = radius-md − space-1).

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Checkboxes, keys, badges, the tab indicator in a small track.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Menu rows, the tab indicator, small buttons.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, the tab track, tooltips.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, popovers, menus, toasts.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Dialogs and sheets.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Switches, slider thumbs, radios, avatars, pills.

shadow.note: The elevation ladder. Light falls from straight above, so shadows only fall down. Every level uses the same four layers (rim, hairline, key, ambient): any two interpolate smoothly. The hairline fades as a surface climbs; the shadow takes over the separating.

tokens.name: trench
tokens.usage: Level -2, inset. Slider, switch and progress tracks; the invalid field.

tokens.name: well
tokens.usage: Level -1, inset. Inputs, textareas, the tab track, unchecked checkboxes and radios.

tokens.name: elev-0
tokens.usage: Level 0, flush. Ghost buttons, badges, skeletons, disabled and pressed controls. Same four-layer shape as every level, so transitions interpolate.

tokens.name: elev-1
tokens.usage: Level 1, raised. Cards, secondary buttons, the switch thumb, the active tab, avatars, keys.

tokens.name: elev-2
tokens.usage: Level 2, lifted. Primary button at rest; anything raised while hovered or focused.

tokens.name: elev-3
tokens.usage: Level 3, floating. Tooltips, popovers, menus, a dragged slider thumb.

tokens.name: elev-4
tokens.usage: Level 4, overlay. The front toast; sheets.

tokens.name: elev-5
tokens.usage: Level 5, modal. Dialogs only.

tokens.name: lip-top
tokens.usage: Overflow cue: the inner shadow at the top edge of a scroll area when content continues above it.

tokens.name: lip-bottom
tokens.usage: Overflow cue: the inner shadow at the bottom edge of a scroll area when content continues below it.

duration.note: Duration is distance: 100ms plus 40ms per level travelled. Exits run at 70% of the entry.

tokens.name: dur-press
tokens.usage: Pressing down to the ground.

tokens.name: dur-travel-1
tokens.usage: One level: hover lift, colour and fill changes, checkbox and radio state.

tokens.name: dur-travel-2
tokens.usage: Two levels: tab indicator, switch thumb, menu highlight, field messages.

tokens.name: dur-travel-3
tokens.usage: Three levels: tooltips, popovers, menus, accordion open.

tokens.name: dur-travel-4
tokens.usage: Four levels: toasts, sheets.

tokens.name: dur-travel-5
tokens.usage: Five levels: dialogs, and the page receding behind them.

tokens.name: dur-sweep
tokens.usage: One pass of the skeleton's light sweep; the indeterminate progress loop.

tokens.name: dur-grace
tokens.usage: A write that confirms within this never shows as pending: fast saves stay invisible.

tokens.name: dur-onset
tokens.usage: Gradual onset of non-predicted menu items (ephemeral adaptation).

tokens.name: dur-hold
tokens.usage: How long a HoldButton must be held to push through the ground and commit.

tokens.name: dur-hover
tokens.usage: One breath of a pending surface hovering above the ground.

tokens.name: dur-settle
tokens.usage: Afterglow: new or changed content arrives at level 2 and settles to its resting level over this long.

easing.note: Things rise decelerating, sink accelerating, and controls that snap into place settle with a 2–3% overshoot.

tokens.name: ease-rise
tokens.usage: Anything entering or gaining altitude.

tokens.name: ease-sink
tokens.usage: Anything leaving or losing altitude.

tokens.name: ease-settle
tokens.usage: Thumbs, indicators, checks and a button released after a press.

tokens.name: ease-glide
tokens.usage: Size and position changes that stay at one level: accordion height, progress width.

tokens.name: ease-decay
tokens.usage: Afterglow decay, after the first second at full strength: fades steadily, the last of it lingers.

thickness.note: Pressable controls show their altitude as a visible wall under the face. Hover adds 1px; pressing removes the wall.

tokens.name: wall-1
tokens.usage: Level-1 pressables: secondary buttons and keys. Breadcrumb steps add 1px per level of depth.

tokens.name: wall-2
tokens.usage: Level-2 pressables: primary and danger buttons.

zIndex.note: Paint order follows altitude, except toasts paint above a dialog so status is never hidden.

tokens.name: z-floating
tokens.usage: Tooltips, popovers, menus.

tokens.name: z-overlay
tokens.usage: Sheets.

tokens.name: z-modal
tokens.usage: Dialog and its scrim.

tokens.name: z-toast
tokens.usage: The toast stack.
